hero.title: Find where intelligence creates value.
hero.description: Identify high-value AI opportunities mapped to real business workflows and measurable outcomes.

why.title: Not every workflow is worth automating
why.body: The organisations that get the most from AI start by finding the right opportunities — the workflows where intelligence creates measurable value and is feasible to deliver. Disciplined discovery prevents wasted investment in capabilities that never move a business metric.

methodology.title: Five phases from question to prioritised roadmap

items.title: Business workflows
items.description: Where does effort concentrate, and where would intelligence create leverage?

items.title: Data readiness
items.description: Is the data available, accessible and good enough to support the use case?

items.title: Feasibility
items.description: Can this be delivered reliably with acceptable effort and risk?

items.title: Measurable value
items.description: Will it move a business metric that matters — and can we prove it?
